newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia govt condemns Indonesian cargo bans.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia govt condemns Indonesian cargo bans.

text.p: Australian Industrial Relations Minister Peter Reith said on Wednesday the Maritime Union of Australia's (MUA) decision to impose bans on Indonesian cargo and shipping attacked the national interest.
Reith called on Opposition Leader Kim Beazley to condemn the MUA's actions, saying failure to do so would further confirm the weakness of his leadership of the labour movement.
"The MUA's actions will exacerbate concern amongst all Australia's trading partners," Reith said in a statement.
The MUA imposed the bans in protest against the recent arrest of two Indonesian independent labour leaders.
Reith said the bans would confirm the impression that Australia was an unreliable supplier and that there was little prospect of improving the productivity of the Australia waterfront.
"The union movement should give up such stunts and concentrate on serving the interests of its members and the national economy," he said.
The union said earlier on Wednesday the bans were also a response to Prime Minister John Howard's failure in Jakarta to press Indonesia on the issue of human rights and democracy.
